items.title: CalDAV集成SSRF致内网探测
items.summary_zh: 具备日历账户配置权限者可通过server_url发起SSRF，探测或访问内网服务
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制server_url出站并禁用非必要CalDAV
items.repro_note: 调用testConnection并控制server_url，需日历账户配置
items.impact_scope: 日历集成组件，可探测内网
items.description: The affected flow begins at CalendarAccount::action_testConnection and uses server_url, CalDAVProvider::makeCalDAVRequest(), and PROPFIND to carry attacker-controlled data or authorization state into the security-sensitive operation. The server sends a PROPFIND request from its network context and returns non-success response bodies, enabling internal-service access, partial response disclosure, service enumeration, and possible cloud metadata access.

items.title: FreeSWITCH API命令注入在野利用
items.title_zh: FreeSWITCH API命令注入在野利用
items.summary_zh: 被接受MESSAGE的SIP对端可选择api chat协议，以守护进程权限执行FreeSWITCH或系统命令
items.action_zh: 立即升级修复版本；禁用api chat协议并限制不可信SIP对端
items.repro_note: 向FreeSWITCH发送MESSAGE并选择api chat协议
items.description: Selecting the api chat proto reached switch_api_execute(), allowing a peer whose MESSAGE was accepted to run FreeSWITCH API commands, including operating-system command sinks, with the daemon's privileges. The flaw permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution, and exploitation has been observed in the wild.

items.title: AOW工作流控制器文件包含
items.title_zh: AOW工作流控制器文件包含
items.summary_zh: 可控制aow_action者利用路径穿越影响require_once，可能导致代码执行或敏感文件包含
items.action_zh: 升级至7.15.2/8.10.2；校验aow_action并禁用危险包含
items.repro_note: 向AOW工作流控制器传入路径穿越的aow_action参数
items.description: Prior to 7.15.2 and 8.10.2, the workflow controller uses a path-traversal-capable aow_action value in require_once() without constraining the resolved file. The affected flow begins at modules/AOW_WorkFlow/controller.php and uses aow_action, and require_once() to carry attacker-controlled data or authorization state into the security-sensitive operation.

items.title: OpenHuman外部消息致持久化命令执行
items.title_zh: OpenHuman外部消息致持久化命令执行
items.summary_zh: 可向已配置外部通道发消息者，可令代理未经审批创建shell定时任务并以运行时权限执行
items.action_zh: 升级至0.57.13；限制外部通道消息来源并审查cron
items.repro_note: 向已配置外部通道发送诱导消息，触发审批缺失创建cron
items.impact_scope: AI代理运行时，消息通道入口
items.description: Before version 0.57.13, an attacker who can send messages to a configured external channel can cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval. The scheduler later executes these jobs with the privileges of the OpenHuman runtime user.

items.title: LMFDB知识渲染SSTI可远程RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向/knowledge/render/<ID>注入Jinja表达式，可执行系统命令并控制Web账户
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交01829bd之后；过滤模板输入并禁用危险渲染
items.impact_scope: 数学数据库Web应用，或公网暴露
items.description: LMFDB before commit 01829bd contains a server-side template injection vulnerability in the render_knowl function that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject Jinja expressions via request parameters. Attackers can supply crafted query-string values or 'content' data to /knowledge/render/<ID> to reach Python builtins and execute operating system commands as the web application account.
